title: Xenoblade Chronicles: Definitive Edition
description: Join Shulk and his companions in a remastered version of the classic Xenoblade adventure. Explore the Bionis and Mechonis, use visions to influence battle outcomes, customize your party, and continue the story in Future Connected.

description_short: The definitive remaster of Shulk’s adventure across the Bionis and Mechonis, including Future Connected.
description_ar: انضم إلى شلك ورفاقه في النسخة المحسنة من مغامرة Xenoblade الأصلية. استكشف جسدي Bionis وMechonis، واستفد من رؤى المستقبل في المعارك، وطوّر الفريق والمعدات، ثم واصل القصة في فصل Future Connected المضمن.
nintendoNotes:
Official platform status: Nintendo Switch version released 2020-05-29. A native Nintendo Switch 2 Edition is also available in 2026 with 4K TV output, full-HD handheld output and 60 fps, plus Ether Jet traversal, extra equipment and fully voiced Heart-to-Hearts.

Supplier language selection: Simplified Chinese. Supplier matrix: NS1 Regular ¥11.7 (pre-discount ¥15); NS1 Standard ¥173.4; NS2 Regular ¥21.5; NS2 Standard ¥193. Two supplier variants per platform means no DLC product type.
Converted costs: NS1 Regular 2,500 IQD; NS1 Standard 38,000 IQD; NS2 Regular 4,500 IQD; NS2 Standard 42,250 IQD.
Because the current template has no platform-specific type.cost field, active type.cost values remain blank instead of selecting an incorrect platform cost.

tagline: Discover the origins of Shulk and the power of the Monado.

gameplayPillars.title: Vision and tactical reactions
gameplayPillars.description: Shulk’s visions can reveal dangerous future events, allowing the player to respond with Arts, positioning, buffs, or party coordination.

gameplayPillars.title: Explore the titans
gameplayPillars.description: Large regions reward exploration with landmarks, quests, unique monsters, collectibles, and hidden routes.

gameplayPillars.title: Build the party
gameplayPillars.description: Party building combines Arts, equipment, gems, affinity, skill links, and Chain Attacks.

worldSummary: The world is formed around the bodies of two colossal titans, Bionis and Mechonis, locked in an ancient conflict. Settlements, wilderness, ruins, and battlefields stretch across their bodies.

storyChapters.title: A world on two titans
storyChapters.body: Life on Bionis is shattered by a renewed Mechon assault, placing Shulk and the Monado at the center of a larger conflict.

storyChapters.title: Shulk and the Monado
storyChapters.body: The journey across Bionis and Mechonis gradually reveals the origins of the Monado, the Mechon, and the world itself.

storyChapters.title: Future Connected
storyChapters.body: Future Connected is an included epilogue set after the main story, adding a new region and a continuation for key characters.

features: Large interconnected areas across Bionis and Mechonis
perfNotes: Nintendo Switch targets 30 fps with dynamic resolution around 504p-720p docked and 378p-540p handheld. Nintendo Switch 2 Edition officially runs at 60 fps with 4K TV output and full-HD handheld output.
storageNotes: Nintendo lists 13.7 GB for the Switch version and 33.8 GB for the native Switch 2 Edition.
verdictSummary: A highly rated remaster that preserves the original’s story and combat while substantially improving presentation and usability. The Switch 2 Edition further improves clarity and frame rate.

timeline.title: Definitive Edition releases on Nintendo Switch
timeline.body: Definitive Edition released worldwide on Switch.

timeline.title: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition digital release
timeline.body: Nintendo Switch 2 digital edition released with performance and content enhancements.

timeline.title: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition physical release in North America
timeline.body: North American physical Switch 2 Edition followed later in July 2026.
